what: One cell of the photo strip rests at the center of the plate for 2.4s, then slides 1.5s with cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1) so the next cell lands at the center (first rest .8s). After the last cell the first cell follows, looping endlessly. On first entry the plate grows from .85x and transparent, overshooting slightly back after .9s (back .34,1.56,.64,1), and appears at .5s — onto a Hero where round photos drift sideways

options.pause: Seconds held still at the center, default 2.4
options.slide: Seconds to glide to the next cell, default 1.5
options.first: Initial pause in seconds (first slide after entering is first + slide), default .8
options.wait: Name of the document event to wait for — give the event fired when the loader clears, and it enters and starts spinning then (Brand comes after the loader)
options.look: With plain, it shows right away without the scale-up entrance
options.[data-fx-part=track]: Strip holding the cells (child) — put only real cells in. The part adds the clones

from.where: index.html .hm-fv__slider (strip of six bean-shaped photos — original function.js setFvSlider: pauseTime 2400 · firstPauseTime 800 · slideTime 1500 · cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1), re-centers after 300ms when the window is resized, the .fv-slider panel fades in with opacity .5s ease-out · scale .85→1 .9s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), starts after the loader clears)
